links.comparator_used: Single image (SI) input with no added radiology description
links.outcome: ONFH detection AUC; early vs late staging accuracy; detailed grading accuracy (Ficat, ARCO, Steinberg); ARCO grading reliability (ICC)
links.effect: Detection mean AUC 0.55 (SD 0.03) SI vs 0.91 (SD 0.01) ID; radiograph detection accuracy 0.88 and MRI 0.85 with ID; early vs late accuracy 0.65 (SD 0.11) SI vs 0.78 (SD 0.04) ID; ARCO ICC 0.51 (SD 0.18) SI vs 0.97 (SD 0.02) ID
links.quote: For ONFH detection, the SI configuration yielded a mean detection area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.55 (SD 0.03), whereas the ID configuration achieved a mean detection AUC of 0.91 (SD 0.01).

design_hint: prompt configuration (adding radiology description to image input)
